name: Web Express
summary: Brisbane dialup ISP (8c/hour, web authoring, home page hosting, ~1997); defunct (THE TRUSTEE FOR WEB EXPRESS UNIT TRUST (t/a Web Express Pty Ltd, trustee company ACN 105 458 605), ACN 105 458 605).

events.details: Website gone (no live site) — genuine ISP site last seen Feb 2012; bare 'Index of /' by Apr 2013.

refs.label: Still a genuine ISP page in Feb 2012.
By Apr 2013 the site is just a directory listing; cPanel 'suspendedpage.cgi' follows in 2014, then 'Southern Ocean Systems - Coming Soon' by 2021.
ABR: THE TRUSTEE FOR WEB EXPRESS UNIT TRUST (t/a Web Express Pty Ltd, trustee company ACN 105 458 605)
Verified verbatim: the ISP's own Nov 2003 page names the buyer Web Express Pty. Ltd., ACN 105 458 605
ABR verified: the trust trading as 'Web Express Pty Ltd' from 28 Jul 2003 — within a fortnight of the announced 8 Aug 2003 sale; Brisbane postcode matches the B
